_doc: EVERY materiality/clarification CRITERION, alive or dead. A criterion may be PROMOTED only when validated_on_corpus differs from derived_from_corpus. Four criteria have died to the same error: a rule inferred from the cases it was tested on. Enforced by tests/test_no_criterion_promoted_from_its_own_corpus.py. ⭐ 2026-08-31: entries now declare a `kind`. A `corpus_criterion` is a claim about food and must clear the held-out gate. An `architectural_invariant` is a claim about the SYSTEM -- it is not derived from a corpus and no corpus can validate it, so it clears a DIFFERENT and stricter gate: it must name a live mechanical proof that collects, passes, and contains no xfail. The label is not an escape hatch; it swaps one obligation for a harder one.

criteria.name: magnitude_span_threshold
criteria.claim: an ask is material when its calorie span exceeds a threshold
criteria.note: Disproved 2026-08-27. impact_cal overlaps almost completely across asking and logging cases. Do not resurrect: regression-by-forgetting.

criteria.name: dish_vs_vessel
criteria.claim: a name denoting a serving VESSEL has no defensible default; a DISH does
criteria.note: Fitted to 3 fixtures. Declared falsified on n=1 (burrito bowl logged 1/1) and the FALSIFICATION did not survive n=8 (0/8). Both the rule and its refutation were underpowered.

criteria.name: four_criterion_evidence_contract
criteria.claim: recognized archetype + conventional serving + bounded interpretation + statable assumption
criteria.note: Drafted entirely on invalid-config behaviour (all 18 render.yaml flags unset). Superseded before it was ever tested.

criteria.name: h1_unspecified_secondary_component
criteria.claim: the system asks when a confidently-priced PRIMARY is accompanied by an UNSPECIFIED SECONDARY component
criteria.note: REFUTED 2026-08-27 by its own preregistered falsification conditions. c110 asks with no secondary; c111 asks about the PRIMARY. Matched pairs separated 2 of 4. ⭐ The gate WORKED: derived on one corpus, tested on another, and died there instead of in production.

criteria.name: h2_unbounded_quantity
criteria.claim: the ask fires when a component's quantity is UNBOUNDED by the utterance; countable items ('a croissant') count as bounded
criteria.note: 12/12 in-sample, 6/8 out-of-sample against the 8 DEFAULTABILITY cases. NOT PROMOTED: derived post-hoc from the very cases that refuted H1. Needs its OWN held-out corpus.

criteria.name: shape_c_unstated_extras_report_only_field
criteria.claim: a REPORT-ONLY `extras` field lets the model name an unresolved subject without gaining permission to default it, reducing asks without losing material ones
criteria.note: ⛔ PERMANENTLY REJECTED 2026-08-31 by arms E1/E2/E3 at `83342c6` (_code_sha 26ff8f5), 150 turns, every preregistered refusal condition clear. C off 22/50 and 23/50; C ON 30/50. Null envelope 1, effect +7.5 -- OUTSIDE it, in the HARM direction. C does not reduce asking, it INCREASES it by 15 points, broad across 8 of 25 cases. ⭐ So the original apparent benefit was not PARTLY the denominator artifact: the artifact WAS the benefit and was masking an effect of the opposite sign. There is no second beneficial mechanism to rescue. Mechanism, c1: with C off the unknown is reported as `prep` and sized against the 960-cal sandwich (15.6% < 30% dial) -> immaterial; with C on it is `extras` with NO establishable basis, so the day fraction decides alone (6.0% vs a 1% dial) -> material. Retained ONLY as a historical causal arm (`FOOD_EXTRAS_REPORT_ONLY`, false in render.yaml, guarded by tests/test_a_rejected_arm_cannot_drift_back_on.py). If the implementation ever becomes a maintenance burden, delete the executable branch and keep THIS entry -- the experiment is what has value, not the dead code.

criteria.name: materiality_is_representation_invariant
criteria.claim: materiality must consume an INVARIANT impact basis for the unresolved component — the same unknown gets the same decision whether it is its own staged row or an ambiguity on its parent
criteria.note: PROMOTED 2026-08-31. ⭐ NOT a corpus claim and no corpus could settle it -- it was derived by characterising the policy itself and is proven mechanically: a 6-parent x 10-span representation grid, controls in both directions, and a TWO-DIRECTIONAL mutation proof (revert -> the four invariance tests red; flatten -> the anti-flattening control red), each with the failure NAME the mutation predicted. Residual: exactly ONE calorie of disagreement between encodings, pinned so it cannot widen. ⚠ BEHAVIOURALLY DORMANT with C off -- 0/37 and 0/47 facts carried a NOT-ESTABLISHED basis in arms E1/E2, because nothing but C emits a component-scoped field. Its effect on ask rate has been measured ONLY in C's presence; a new producer of such a field is a new measurement.

criteria.name: day_share_override_predicate_divergence
criteria.claim: the two materiality entry points — materiality.is_material and ambiguity.materiality — must agree
criteria.note: REGISTERED 2026-08-31, own tranche. Measured: they disagree on 23.3% of a 12,000-cell grid; 2,793 of 2,794 disagreements are the DAY_SHARE_OVERRIDE branch (the per-question staged scorer has neither DAY_SHARE_OVERRIDE nor MIN_ITEM_SHARE). NOT causal for the condiment asks — in that region the two agree — so this is a real defect that was NOT the one being hunted.

criteria.name: condiment_span_truthfulness
criteria.claim: the model's reported impact_cal for a condiment quantity unknown is a truthful span
criteria.note: REGISTERED 2026-08-31, UPSTREAM of materiality and explicitly NOT a prerequisite to rejecting C (Danny). The policy consumes the model's number with no independent check. Captured condiment spans: mayo 120, ranch 100, ranch 80, spicy mayo 150 — against a MIN_ITEM_SHARE gate calibrated on honey 21, soy sauce 10, hot-sauce drizzle 20.

criteria.name: priceability_gate_infers_completeness_from_magnitude
criteria.claim: nutrition validity must be established by FIELD PRESENCE and provenance, never by calorie magnitude — a legitimate zero and a missing zero are different evidence states
criteria.note: ⛔ CONFIRMED DEFECT 2026-08-31, repair NOT authorized. `off._per100g` uses `10 <= kcal/100g <= 900` as a proxy for data completeness. Measured against live OFF: Coca-Cola Zero (0.2 kcal/100g), Coca-Cola Zero Caffeine Free (0.3), Gatorade Zero Glacier Cherry (0.0) and Zero Sugar Thirst Quencher (0.0) are all discarded WITH ALL FOUR MACRO FIELDS POPULATED. Affected class: diet soda, zero-sugar sports drinks, seltzer/flavoured water, black coffee. Fixture cost 2/15 branded probes — NOT production prevalence. ⭐ The invariant to encode: absent -> not established; present as 0 -> zero IS evidence; absurd (9999) -> reject. A complete 0/0/0/0 panel is legitimate; calories=0 with null macros is a different state entirely. Census landed first (event=priceability_rejected, with reason class, calories, macro_fields_present, n_present and the predicate) so production can price the defect before anyone edits the gate. Same shape as the times_used defect the same day: a value meaning one thing, read as evidence of another.
